verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents several programmatic automation paths. API keys let external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses. The Computer gateway exposes workspaces as OpenAI-compatible models, so any OpenAI-style client can run agent tasks. Server-side scheduled automations and tasks run through the normal pipeline without a user present. However, nothing documents a CI integration or a non-interactive CLI mode beyond a single `cptr run` command whose headless behavior is unexplained, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline usage (e.g. GitHub Actions examples), a documented headless/non-interactive CLI mode, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
